faq.question: What is RAG?
faq.answer: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) retrieves relevant documents from a knowledge base and passes them to an LLM so its answer is grounded in your own data.

faq.question: What is an embedding?
faq.answer: An embedding is a list of numbers (a vector) that represents the meaning of a piece of text. Texts with similar meaning have vectors that point in similar directions.

faq.question: What is cosine similarity?
faq.answer: Cosine similarity measures the angle between two vectors: 1.0 means identical direction (same meaning), 0 means unrelated, -1 means opposite.

faq.question: What is a vector database?
faq.answer: A vector database stores embeddings and lets you quickly find the vectors closest to a query vector. Examples: Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS, pgvector.

faq.question: Why do LLMs hallucinate?
faq.answer: LLMs predict likely text, not verified facts. Without grounding data they can produce fluent but wrong answers. RAG reduces this by supplying real context.

faq.question: What is chunking in RAG?
faq.answer: Chunking splits large documents into smaller pieces (e.g. 200-500 tokens) before embedding, so retrieval returns focused, relevant passages.

faq.question: What is semantic caching?
faq.answer: Semantic caching stores previous question/answer pairs. If a new question is nearly identical in meaning (very high similarity), the cached answer is returned without calling the LLM, saving cost and latency.

faq.question: How do I reset my password?
faq.answer: Go to Settings > Account > Reset Password, enter your email, and follow the link sent to your inbox.

faq.question: What are your support hours?
faq.answer: Support is available Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm.

faq.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
faq.answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Cancel Subscription. Your plan stays active until the end of the billing period.
